real_ui_create_run.evidence: Playwright loaded the production export as Open Design and POST /api/runs returned 202 from the page origin.

sse_before_terminal.evidence: The browser observed first-sse-before-terminal while the run status was running.

project_file_write.evidence: maverick-spike.html appeared through the project files API.

full_correlation.evidence: session/new contains only cwd and mcpServers; the custom profile receives no OpenDesign run id, Maverick runtime session id, or turn id.

bidirectional_idempotent_cancel.evidence: Two cancel requests returned 200, the terminal package was canceled, and the live ACP peer received session/cancel once.

timeout.evidence: A silent ACP prompt reached failed and produced a failed terminal package under the configured stage timeout.

backend_restart.evidence: No durable OD-run to Maverick-session/turn mapping can be written because those identifiers never reach the custom ACP peer.

no_provider_secret.evidence: The daemon launched with env -i and every shim trace recorded an empty provider_secret_names array.

actor_attribution.evidence: ACP initialize, session/new, and session/prompt carry no Maverick actor or app-owned session attribution.

terminal_result_packages.evidence: Result packages matched succeeded, failed, timeout-failed, and canceled terminal states.

resume.evidence: A second conversation run succeeded but the custom profile started session/new again; local profiles inherit Kimi, which does not declare resumesSessionViaAcpLoad.

run_scoped_capability.evidence: The custom profile can only receive static profile env; the only upstream run trace env is restricted to agent id amr.

option_a_acp.rejection_reason: A would require a new runtime definition plus daemon spawn/env changes to carry identity and a per-run capability. That is an invasive runtime patch under the approved algorithm, and inheriting another CLI profile would be forbidden emulation.

rules: verify source-app ownership for read and interrupt
deduplicate submission by workspace, source app, and idempotency key
resume after the last acknowledged sequence
redact credentials and full prompt content from audit

app_owned_translation.attribution: The authenticated Maverick actor is persisted with the app-owned mapping; OpenDesign receives an app-owned session attribution, never a Maverick cookie or actor credential.
app_owned_translation.recovery: Reload the persisted mapping, inspect the generic stream after last_sequence, reconcile exactly one terminal package, and resume SSE from the next sequence.
app_owned_translation.idempotency: workspace_id + od_run_id is unique; submit and terminal translation use separate stable idempotency keys.

follow_up.core_primitive: WP7 after the generic access boundary in WP4
